Entering 10 in Price min while 'Free items only' is ON turns 'Free items only' OFF.
Entering Price Min = 200 and Max = 50 and blurring the field automatically swaps the values to Min = 50 and Max = 200.
Clearing Price Min (empty) with Max = 200 and applying filters defaults empty Min to 0 (results priced 0–200).
With location permission denied and 'Meetup' selected, Distance is disabled and displays helper text 'Turn on location to use this'.
With location permission denied, 'Nearest' sort is disabled and displays helper text 'Turn on location to use this'.

Removing the 'Meetup' chip directly from the results header resets Sort from 'Nearest' to 'Best match'.
Reopening the filter panel and tapping 'Reset' returns all filters to their default state.

checklist_items.item: Rule 1 (Free → Price): Turning 'Free items only' on clears the Price range.
Rule 1 (Price → Free): Typing/entering a value in Price range turns 'Free items only' off.
Rule 2 (Min > Max): Entering Price min greater than max swaps the two values on blur.
Rule 2 (Empty min): Leaving Price min empty treats the lower bound as 0.
Rule 2 (Empty max): Leaving Price max empty treats the upper bound as unbounded (no upper limit).
Rule 3 (Meetup off → Distance): Deselecting Meetup resets Distance to 'Any' and disables Distance.
Rule 3 (Distance until Meetup on): Distance stays disabled until Meetup is selected.
Rule 4 (Permission denied → Distance/Nearest): Denied location permission disables both Distance and Nearest sort and shows helper text 'Turn on location to use this'.
Rule 4 (Permission granted → Distance/Nearest): Granting location permission enables both Distance and Nearest sort without reopening the panel.
Rule 5 (Nearest → Meetup): Choosing Nearest sort automatically selects Meetup if not already selected.
Rule 5 (Meetup → Nearest): Deselecting Meetup while Nearest sort is active reverts sort to Best match.
Rule 6 (Free on → Price sorts): Turning 'Free items only' on hides 'Price low→high' and 'Price high→low' sorts and falls back an active price sort to Best match.
Rule 6 (Free off → Price sorts): Turning 'Free items only' off makes 'Price low→high' and 'Price high→low' sorts visible again.
Rule 7 (no_condition Category → Condition): Selecting a no_condition category hides the Condition filter and clears selected conditions.
Rule 7 (Normal Category ← no_condition): Switching back from a no_condition category to a normal category does NOT restore previously selected conditions.
Chain: With Nearest sort active, removing the Meetup chip resets Distance and reverts sort to Best match.
Chain: Turning 'Free items only' on while 'Price low→high' sort is active and price range is set clears price range and falls back sort to Best match.
Reset restores every default listed in the PRD (no category, no price, Free off, no condition, no deal method, Distance 'Any', Sort 'Best match').
The 'Show N results' button updates live as filters change.
